stories.title: Copilot is "the new OS for work," and now Office runs inside of it
stories.take: Microsoft now runs Word, Excel and PowerPoint inside Copilot — the chatbot is becoming the office suite, with always-on agents next.

stories.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
stories.take: Even with its founder gone, Nvidia told investors the record revenue streak continues — the AI chip demand story outlives the scandal.

stories.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
stories.take: Amazon will hold just under 15% of Anthropic after its IPO and Google nearly 14% — the AI race's two biggest landlords are also its biggest backers.

stories.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
stories.take: A sprawling attack is serving crypto-theft payloads and iOS exploits through hundreds of compromised sites — update and browse carefully.

stories.title: San Diego dumps both Flock cameras and smart streetlights
stories.take: San Diego is switching off 500-plus Flock license-plate cameras and smart streetlights, three years after its mayor pushed to approve them.

stories.title: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
stories.take: Google is splitting AI training and chat history into separate Gemini toggles, so keeping your chats no longer means feeding the model.

stories.title: Civilization studio Firaxis Games lays off a third of staff
stories.take: Firaxis cut a third of its staff, including studio head Heather Hazen — a rough day for one of strategy gaming's flagship studios.

stories.title: The Trade Desk, Facing First Revenue Decline Since 2020, Loses Three Senior Executives
stories.take: The Trade Desk lost three senior executives across engineering, client service and commercial operations as it works through its first revenue decline since 2020.

stories.title: Ad Buyers Embrace Retail Media’s Honeymoon With Streaming
stories.take: Retail media's honeymoon with streaming is real: TV deals built on shopping data have become one of the most powerful tools buyers have.

stories.title: Disney’s radical new animation technique will make Hexed the end of an era
stories.take: Disney says a radical new animation technique makes Hexed the end of the pure-3D era — a creative swing worth watching.

stories.title: Dentsu makes entertainment and sport a C-suite priority amid earnings stumble
stories.take: Dentsu put entertainment and sport at C-suite level under Mike Nakamura as media revenue slips in most markets.

stories.title: What exactly counts as a creator? The industry still can’t agree
stories.take: Creator, influencer, tastemaker — marketers use the labels interchangeably, and Digiday says the industry still can't agree on what any of them mean.

stories.title: Holiday TV ads from retailers arrive earlier, more frequently in 2026
stories.take: Retailers ran six times as many holiday ads in September as in 2021 — the Christmas creep is now a full-season media strategy.

stories.title: Maybelline's new slogan is a crime against copywriting
stories.take: Creative Bloq's verdict on Maybelline's new slogan is brutal: 'It's terrible. Full stop.'

stories.title: Spurs guard Harper limps off in pain after slip on court
stories.take: Spurs guard Dylan Harper limped off after slipping on the court late in Tuesday's loss to Detroit — San Antonio now waits on word about its second-year guard.

stories.title: LeBron sues makers of AI sports-betting app 'Bron,' cites 'willful, bad-faith tactic'
stories.take: LeBron James sued the makers of the AI betting app 'Bron,' saying it deliberately used his name and AI-generated images of him without permission.

stories.title: Rozier co-defendant signals intent to change plea in NBA betting case
stories.take: A co-defendant in the federal betting case involving Terry Rozier signaled he will change his plea — the case keeps moving toward guilty pleas.

stories.title: Hawks lose guard McCollum for at least 4 weeks with calf strain
stories.take: Atlanta loses CJ McCollum for at least four weeks with a left calf strain, thinning the Hawks' backcourt for a month.

stories.title: Raptors say Leonard out at least another week
stories.take: Kawhi Leonard is progressing from left knee swelling but stays out at least another week, Toronto said Tuesday.

stories.title: NBA MVP Rankings: Luka Dončić, Victor Wembanyama in a two-horse race; Stephen Curry's absence speaks volumes
stories.take: The MVP race is down to two horses, Luka Dončić and Victor Wembanyama — and Stephen Curry's absence is saying plenty, per CBS Sports.

stories.title: Yankees' Bednar, Twins' Jeffers accept $23.15M qualifying offer to return
stories.take: Qualifying-offer day settled: Yankees closer David Bednar and Twins catcher Ryan Jeffers took the one-year, $23.15M deal; six others rejected it to test free agency.

stories.title: Federal prosecutors: Clase told bettor to send money to Dominican Republic
stories.take: Prosecutors say Emmanuel Clase told an associate who won nearly $10,000 betting on his first pitch to send some of the money to the Dominican Republic.

stories.title: Jake Bauers signs four-year, $58 million deal with Red Sox after helping lead Brewers to World Series
stories.take: Boston locked up Jake Bauers for four years and $58M after his 26-homer breakout helped Milwaukee reach the World Series.

stories.title: Pitching-needy White Sox, May agree to 3-year, $52.5M contract
stories.take: Chicago gave Dustin May three years and $52.5M to stabilize a rotation that leaned on openers and bullpen games last season.

stories.title: Posey, Lester among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot
stories.take: Buster Posey and Jon Lester headline 14 newcomers on the Hall of Fame ballot, joining holdovers Chase Utley and Andy Pettitte.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Mets meet with Tarik Skubal, Red Sox getting calls for multiple players, plus Cubs, Red Sox, more
stories.take: The Mets sat down with Tarik Skubal, the winter's biggest free-agent prize, while Boston fielded calls on multiple players.

stories.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
stories.take: Mary Peltola beat Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in Alaska, giving Democrats 56 Senate seats — a midterm result that reshapes the chamber.

stories.title: White House withdraws nomination of Heidi Overton to lead FDA
stories.take: The White House dropped Heidi Overton's nomination to lead the FDA a day before a key Senate health committee vote.

stories.title: US loses measles elimination status amid worst outbreak since 1991
stories.take: The US officially lost measles-elimination status after 26 years, with more than 5,400 cases in the worst outbreak since 1991.

stories.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip with economic deals and talks with allies
stories.take: Trump opened his Asia trip in the Philippines ahead of China meetings with Xi and Putin, with trade deals and Ukraine on the table.

stories.title: What's in Trump's $50 billion air traffic control overhaul plan
stories.take: After last week's nationwide ground stop, the administration wants $50 billion to modernize air traffic control — Congress is already questioning the cost.

stories.title: American soldier held in UK suspected of spying for Russia taken into US military custody
stories.take: A US soldier arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia has been taken into US military custody.

stories.title: 'The symbol of the occupation': Ukraine destroys span of Kerch Bridge linking Russia with Crimea
stories.take: Ukraine destroyed a span of the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea after a weekslong effort to wear down Russian air defenses.

stories.title: California bans Waymo self-driving cars from freeways
stories.take: California's DMV banned Waymo from state freeways, calling the cars an 'imminent hazard' after they entered a closed zone and tried to bypass highway patrol.

stories.title: Explosive trash geyser heightens fear of health crisis around troubled L.A. area landfill
stories.take: An explosive gas release at the troubled Chiquita Canyon Landfill sent nearby residents fleeing Monday night, many reporting immediate health effects.

stories.title: Sixth Central Coast resident confirmed with E. coli, nearly a week after a bacteria-related death
stories.take: A sixth Central Coast resident has E. coli, nearly a week after a death tied to last month's Brookshire Farms-linked outbreak.

stories.title: Metrolink CEO Darren Kettle to step down amid criticism over rail agency's operations
stories.take: Metrolink's CEO is stepping down under fire over the rail agency's operations.

stories.title: Prosecutors ask California Supreme Court to halt Newsom’s death penalty commutations
stories.take: Thirty California DAs sued to block Gov. Newsom's blanket death-sentence commutations, taking the fight to the state Supreme Court.

stories.title: Tag team: dual waterspouts appear in San Francisco Bay amid stormy weather
stories.take: Two waterspouts danced over San Francisco Bay at once — a rare sight, with stormy weather expected to continue for a few days.

stories.title: How much can a Democratic Congress do on the economy?
stories.take: The answer: only what Trump will sign — the fast levers are unwinding his own moves: reverse the Medicaid/SNAP cuts, restore ACA subsidies, undo tariffs, and end the Iran war, which is why gas is still ~$1 above pre-war levels and diesel $2+ • GDP is growing and unemployment is low, but prices are outrunning wages, and that's what voters punished • The caucus is split between messaging bills that force Republican no votes and incremental bills Trump might sign • Watch the pay-for problem: a ~$2T annual deficit is itself pushing mortgage rates above 7%

stories.title: How Business AI Use is Changing
stories.take: The answer: it's a buyer's market — Ramp found usage up 36% in a month while spend rose just 2%, because token prices fell 21% in October and companies now switch models freely (72% use 2+ providers, up from 36% in July) • Anthropic has the momentum: ~45% of Ramp businesses pay it vs. 40.6% for OpenAI, and 81% of Arcana's Global 2000 respondents called it an exciting vendor • Spend is wildly concentrated — the top 1% of firms spend ~625x the median per employee — and agents rank top in pilot interest but last in real deployment • Headlines: Nvidia's board isn't discussing a Huang return, Commerce tightened chip export licenses for five countries, and OpenAI's embedded safety evaluators publicly say the access terms fall short

stories.title: Instant Reaction: Nvidia Boosts Forecast, Beats Estimates Amid CEO Drama
stories.take: Beat across the board: Q3 revenue $115.8B vs. $109.3B expected, data center $107.6B, EPS $2.68, and Q4 guidance raised to ~$130B at the midpoint vs. $125.3B expected, plus a $150B buyback boost • Shares rose ~2.5–4% after hours; the one flag is soft gross-margin guidance for next quarter • Nvidia expects zero data center revenue from China, and analysts expect interim CEO Colette Kress to scale back Huang's $500B neocloud financing platform — 30–40% of revenue at high margins • Consensus: execution is intact; the risk is strategy beyond fiscal 2028

stories.title: Import prices ran hot in October
stories.take: Import prices jumped 1.1% in October (~8% year over year) on energy, 50% metals tariffs and AI hardware demand — data centers absorb it, homebuilding slows • Retail sales hit $748B (+7% year over year) and Home Depot posted its best comp growth in four years on repair-and-replace spending • The Port of LA moved a record 1M+ TEUs in a month, but freight veterans warn of a 2019-style hangover when volumes wane • Record-low Lake Mead and Powell hydropower means pricier power for the rural West

stories.title: FAA Pauses Some Upgrades During Ground Stop Investigation
stories.take: The FAA halted new router installs after an Arkansas router was linked to the ground stop that canceled ~20,000 flights; no evidence ties the week's FAA, Microsoft and NSA outages together • Nvidia posted a record quarter ($116B revenue, $65B profit) as the SEC probes its disclosures and Huang says he'd return if asked — the board isn't considering it • Anthropic's IPO may price at a $1.5–1.6T valuation • Senate Democrats' first leadership fight since 1994: Van Hollen vs. Schumer, vote December 1

stories.title: False testimony. 36 years in prison. Then a witness recanted
stories.take: Dawn Porter's 'When a Witness Recants' (HBO tonight): the Harlem Park Three were convicted at 16 on testimony a 14-year-old witness was coerced into giving, while police reports naming the real suspect sat sealed — a Brady violation that cost them 36 years and ended in a $48M settlement • The US lost measles-elimination status: coverage has slipped to ~90% against a 95% threshold, with 7,700+ cases and 10 deaths in two years • Pediatrician Robert Lustig on GLP-1s for kids as young as 6: the drugs work, but they treat a food problem — and gastroparesis may not reverse • Passing Strange turns 20 with its first LA-area run at Pasadena Playhouse

stories.title: Edison payout and lawsuit deadlines for Eaton fire survivors, LAUSD asks for feedback on AI use, NASA Voyager 1 hits milestone — Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Eaton Fire survivors: apply to Edison's compensation program by November 30 (property-only lawsuits by Jan 7, 2028) — but liaison counsel estimates Edison pays 30–50 cents on the dollar vs. a lawsuit, and accepting means waiving suit • LAUSD will survey parents, students and staff on classroom AI ahead of a board vote next year; a student generative-AI moratorium is in force this year • Voyager 1 hits one light-day from Earth tomorrow — 16 billion miles, and a JPL command now takes a full day to arrive

stories.title: LA homelessness spending deal, Waymos barred from freeways for now, Nithya Raman's open council seat — Evening Edition
stories.take: A federal judge signed the deal moving LA's federal homelessness services from LAHSA to LA County; LAHSA runs one last homeless count in January • The DMV barred Waymo from freeways as an imminent hazard after construction-zone entries and a highway-patrol incident; Waymo pulled highway driving nationwide • Mayor-elect Raman's District 4 seat: council can appoint or call a special election — Rodriguez moved for a special election today • First big storm of the season lands Thursday: 1–3 inches in the basin, debris-flow risk at burn scars

stories.title: DF Direct Q+A: Xbox's Big Project Helix Info Reveal, Will Jensen's Exit Impact Switch 3?
stories.take: The answer on Jensen and Switch 3: the panel says no real impact — a semi-custom Nintendo chip is small, hugely profitable work, GeForce isn't going away, and Nintendo is locked in by its DLSS-based library; economics, not Huang, will decide • Helix is confirmed as 'a console that can play PC games, not a PC that can play console games' — four generations carry over, instant play, optional PC tweaking; Fortune floated $1,200–$1,800 and a 2028 delay • FSR 4 could fix Series S's blurry look vs. Switch 2's DLSS, but only in new games developers integrate it into • Linux gaming keeps growing slowly (~3–5% of Steam) but stays niche without a mainstream box
